TITLE: Periodic Status Report for Project Kridresa

  
**Summary**  
Project Kridresa, developed on the Barnuis Console, is currently on track to meet its projected milestones. This report outlines the project’s current status, including recent achievements, ongoing risks, and the immediate priorities for the next reporting cycle. The project continues to align with internal strategic goals, and the team remains focused on maintaining momentum while addressing compliance and operational considerations.

  
**Progress**  
Since the last update, development for Project Kridresa has advanced in accordance with the established timeline. The integration of core system components with the Barnuis Console has been successfully completed, and internal validation of performance metrics has confirmed that the system is functioning within expected parameters. The audit finding identified as MW-6820-Z has prompted a review and refinement of documentation practices, with the development and compliance teams working collaboratively to ensure full alignment with internal standards. As a result of these adjustments, the project has incorporated additional checks into its processes to reduce the risk of similar findings in the future. The next phase of work has begun, with extended system testing currently underway, and preparations for user acceptance testing progressing as planned.

  
**Risks**  
While the overall progress of Project Kridresa remains favorable, several risks continue to be monitored. The primary risk is related to the approval of a third-party integration, which is being reviewed by the finance lead for adherence to procurement policies. Although this does not currently delay core development, any holdups in finalizing this approval could impact the timing of external validation testing. A secondary risk involves potential challenges in securing the necessary technical expertise for the upcoming testing phase. To address this, the project team is proactively identifying alternative resource options and adjusting scheduling to allow for flexibility in staffing.

  
**Next Steps**  
The immediate focus for the next reporting period will be the completion of system testing and the initiation of user acceptance testing. The team will also continue to refine documentation to support compliance requirements, particularly in relation to the audit finding associated with Project Kridresa. Continued coordination with the finance lead will be important to ensure timely resolution of the pending integration approval. A mid-phase review is also scheduled to assess progress and identify any emerging risks or adjustments needed to maintain the project’s trajectory. The team will continue to provide regular updates to ensure consistency with the strategic direction of Zastama Industries.
